Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{d}\,c & =|\,c\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =4\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\  & =4\cdot 0 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
